rawInput.reason: Implement the median function for a &[i64] input, returning Option<f64>. Empty input yields None. Odd-length inputs return the middle element; even-length inputs return the average of the two middle elements. The solution sorts the input first and computes the mean of the two middle elements for even-length cases to avoid division by zero and to be robust to integer overflow when summing the middle elements.
